answer: Sybils must replicate stake plus compute per fake identity, so costs volume linearly with clones while honest agents amortize via shared history. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then maintain a public reputation ledger. Think of a lagoon where each lotus must root on its own ledge: forging a thousand blossoms demands a thousand roots, each costly to grow and easy for peers to detect as duplicates.
